essence: Protection of the cheeks is entrusted to Vīreśa and Gaṇḍādimardana.
The teeth and chin are guarded by these two fierce forms.
Each shoulder is placed under a distinct divine guardian.
The left arm and heart receive protection from Sārvabhauma and Pāṇḍura.
The doer of all auspiciousness is the constant guardian in the north.
